exact: positive regulation of endothelial cell chemotaxis by VEGF-activated vascular endothelial growth factor receptor signalling pathway
positive regulation of endothelial cell chemotaxis by VEGF/VEGFR signaling pathway
related: vascular endothelial growth factor receptor signaling pathway involved in endothelial cell chemotaxis

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) to its receptor on the surface of a cell, which activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of endothelial cell chemotaxis.
label: positive regulation of endothelial cell chemotaxis by VEGF-activated vascular endothelial growth factor receptor signaling pathway
